messages:
alex_s (Support): Filing P2 for Acme corp — manager view (role=BillingManager) shows empty charts for last 30d, admins see full data. Ticket #12345. Can someone triage? @maria_p

maria_p (Eng Analytics): I can reproduce with a manager token. Admin token returns expected series. Manager token returns 200 but empty series array. Also saw 403 on historical-aggregates when querying role-scoped endpoint in some cases.

maria_p (Eng Analytics): Repro steps I used:
1) manager token: 
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <mgr-token>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?role=BillingManager&range=30d\"
-> 200 
body: { \"series\": [] }

2) admin token: 
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?role=BillingManager&range=30d\"
-> 200 
body: { \"series\": [...non-empty...] }

kevin_r (Eng Infra): Checked org settings (quick DB query):
SELECT org_id, retention_days, linked_org_override FROM org_settings WHERE org_id = 'acme-123';
-> org_id: acme-123, retention_days: 365, linked_org_override: 14
Looks like linked_org_override was set to 14 days which is wrong.

sasha (Eng SRE): Looking at the retention cleanup logs (job retention-cleanup-v2): found entries applying TTL=14 to prefixes like: \"acme-123/role/BillingManager/agg/2026-03-\". The job applied the linked_org_override when it should have skipped role-scoped aggregates.

olivia_c (Product): How many customers hit by this? Any scopes beyond dashboards (e.g., API/embeddings metrics)?

maria_p (Eng Analytics): Quick scan: 3 orgs in last 48h had linked_org_override < 30 and role-scoped aggregates present. So impact is limited but definitely customer-facing for those orgs. No evidence of embeddings metrics being dropped — just time-series aggregates partitioned by role/org.

kevin_r (Eng Infra): Recovery options:
- Rehydrate missing partitions from hot OLAP backup (we keep 90d). We can re-run aggregation for specific prefixes.
- ETA for single org rehydration: ~2-3 hours. Bulk (3 orgs): ~6-8 hours.

alex_s (Support): Proposed customer msg: \"We're investigating an internal retention config that incorrectly shortened retention for some role-scoped dashboard data. Admins are unaffected. We'll restore missing metrics within ~4 hours and push a fix to prevent recurrence.\" Thoughts?

sasha (Eng SRE): Hotfix plan: patch retention-cleanup to ignore linked_org_override for role-scoped prefixes, roll out to canary now. I rolled canary (deploy-2026-03-17-01) and it's not applying overrides anymore :thumbsup:. I'll promote to prod after 30m canary window.

maria_p (Eng Analytics): Opening PR to add unit tests and an integration test that simulates linked_org_override + role aggregates. Also adding an alert rule: if retention_applied < 30 for orgs with active dashboards, trigger paging.

alex_s (Support): Notifying Acme now with ETA: partial restore start in ~30m, expected visible data for last 30d within 4 hours. Full rollback/cleanup and root-cause fix tomorrow. Marking P2 and escalating.

incidents-bot: Incident ACME-12345 created (sev=P2). Channel: #incidents. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/ACME-12345

sasha (Eng SRE): I'll post updates here once rehydration completes and when prod patch is live.

alex_s (Support): Thanks all — ping me when done so I can update the customer. :white_check_mark:
